# The Functional Tutorial Server
Don't try to brick the server.
## How to play
1. Press the **Join** button in the lobby (bottom of the screen). 2. Pick a job from the list. **Passenger** is at the top — start there for the basics tutorial. 3. After you spawn, follow the on-screen tips (or your mentor). Use the **Choose a tutorial** action (dollar sign) to switch roles, or type `/ghost` and respawn to pick again.
